name: Default
shortDescription: Browser-based non-destructive photo library and raw developer built in Rust and WebAssembly: tone, color grading, masking, presets and export, with photos kept in the user's browser.

alerts.message: Photos and the catalog are not stored on the server: the editor keeps its library in each browser's own storage, which the browser may clear. Keep your originals elsewhere and use File > Back Up Library regularly.
The upstream project publishes no container image; this one is built by a community maintainer from the official releases.
